items.meaning: DHCP 提供 BOOTP 所提供功能的超集。
DHCP 消息格式基于 BOOTP 消息格式。
BOOTP 的 vendor extensions 字段在 DHCP 中被重命名为 options 字段。
BOOTP vendor extensions 字段内的标记数据项现在简称为 options。
带有 DHCP message type 选项类型 1 的 DHCP 消息称为 DHCPDISCOVER 消息。
DHCP 消息格式与 BOOTP 消息格式兼容，使现有 BOOTP 客户端可与 DHCP 服务器互操作。
DHCP 服务器收到的包含 'DHCP message type' (51) 选项的消息被假定由 DHCP 客户端发送。
items.constraint: Any message received by a DHCP server that includes a 'DHCP message type' (51) option is assumed to have been sent by a DHCP client.
items.action: assumed to have been sent by
items.condition: Any message received by a DHCP server that includes a 'DHCP message type' (51) option

items.meaning: 不含 DHCP Message Type 选项的消息被假定由 BOOTP 客户端发送。
items.constraint: Messages without the DHCP Message Type option are assumed to have been sent by a BOOTP client.
items.action: assumed to have been sent by
items.condition: Messages without the DHCP Message Type option

items.meaning: DHCP 服务器对 BOOTP 客户端的支持由本地系统管理员自行决定，属于可选功能。
未配置支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器收到 BOOTP 客户端的 BOOTREQUEST 时静默丢弃该消息。
items.constraint: If a DHCP server that is not configured to support BOOTP clients receives a BOOTREQUEST message from a BOOTP client, that server silently discards the BOOTREQUEST message.
items.condition: If a DHCP server that is not configured to support BOOTP clients receives a BOOTREQUEST message from a BOOTP client

items.meaning: 配置为支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器可被配置为提供静态地址、自动地址或两者。
items.constraint: If a DHCP server is configured to support BOOTP clients, it may be configured to supply static addresses, automatic addresses or both.
items.object: static addresses, automatic addresses or both
items.condition: If a DHCP server is configured to support BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 静态地址是先前由系统管理员分配并存储在 DHCP 服务器可用数据库中的地址。
